EVAL-F-002-S1.title: Provider Detail Schema and Contract Definition
EVAL-F-002-S1.description: Define the response schema for provider detail lookup including NPI, name, specialty, license status, practice address, phone number, and enumeration date. Ensure alignment with downstream facade and chat response formatting.

EVAL-F-002-S2.title: NPI Provider Detail Retrieval Logic
EVAL-F-002-S2.description: Implement core service logic to call the CMS NPI Registry API, parse provider credentials, normalize fields (specialty, license, status), and handle missing or incomplete records.

EVAL-F-002-S3.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration for Provider Detail
EVAL-F-002-S3.description: Integrate provider detail service into evaluate_care_facade to enable tool-based retrieval and ensure compatibility with existing evaluation workflows.

EVAL-F-002-S4.title: Provider Detail API Exposure
EVAL-F-002-S4.description: Expose provider detail lookup through FastAPI endpoint and tool router, enabling LLM tool-use access with validated inputs and structured outputs.

EVAL-F-002-S5.title: Provider Detail Unit and Integration Tests
EVAL-F-002-S5.description: Create unit tests for NPI parsing and normalization, and integration tests covering end-to-end flow from API call through facade to service.
EVAL-F-002-S5.evidence: GAP: No existing provider detail test file found; must be implemented in backend/tests
